messages.author: c7c54e822c5daae0
messages.subject: interpretation of sleep visualisation graphs
parts:
Hi, 

Can someone please help me with the interpretation of the visual sleep log generated by the GGIR package. I have read through the following link: 
https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIR.html

The link does not explain what the different colours in the pdf file stand for. I am attaching the visualisation_sleep.pdf. Can someone help me interpret a day or two from this file.

Kind regards,
Parneet

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] interpretation of sleep visualisation graphs
parts:
Hi Parneet,

These are the unique combinations of arguments time threshold and angle thresholds. These are mainly intended for methodological interested in comparing configurations and/or sensitivity analysis. Adding a legend would be the best solution.

It has been on the list of outstanding issues on GitHub for a long time: https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/issues/24 If anyone wants to develop this and make a pull request or pay me to work on it then let me know.

Best,
Vincent

messages.author: c7c54e822c5daae0
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] interpretation of sleep visualisation graphs
parts:
Thanks for that Vincent. The link mentions that  the graphs are a visualization of how sleep period time and sustained inactivity bouts match throughout a day. My understanding by this is that the colours indicate the sustained activity bouts and sleep period. Is that correct? Which colour (red, blue, green, yellow, the bars with slanted lines) indicates the sustained inactivity bouts and which one is for the sleep period. In my code I used the angle threshold as 5 and time threshold as c(5,10).  I understand that  the sleep period and inactivity bouts are calculated using unique combinations of arguments of time threshold and angle thresholds so I assume the colours and patterns are for the unique combinations of these.  

kind regards,
Parneet
